note: Neutral source of truth for the agent roster. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/sync-agents.mjs` (or `upd agents`) to write the per-harness files. Nothing downstream is hand-edited.

omp.comment: omp reads ~/.omp/agent/agents/*.md. It supports everything here natively: autoloadSkills, spawns, model roles, thinkingLevel.

claude.comment: Claude Code reads ~/.claude/agents/*.md. Different tool names, different model vocabulary, `skills` instead of autoloadSkills. Generated, never edited.

openbot.comment: OpenBot has no agent files. Its agents are runtime records, so those are created through openbot-cli by scripts/sync-agents.mjs --openbot against a running app.
